output: Thanks for raising this, because it is the right question to ask before rollout. Model building does have a learning curve, and most non-finance users shouldn't be designing models at all; their job is to enter and review numbers. The product gives each role its own input view, and onboarding includes admin training so that a trained internal admin, not a consultant, handles routine model changes. For proof, [PLACEHOLDER] customer story: operations team updated its own headcount drivers after admin training. I'd suggest a hands-on session where two of your clinic managers, or other non-finance budget owners, complete a real input task in a sandbox, so you can see how it feels for them before anything goes live.
